lines.zh: 长鼻贴着落叶层，一路嗅蚁道。
lines.en: Long snout pressed to the leaf litter, tracing ant trails.

lines.zh: 大爪收在掌下，走路一颠一颠。
lines.en: Big claws folded under, it trundles along in a wobble.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，扫开一层枯叶。
lines.en: Its bushy tail drags behind, sweeping the dead leaves aside.

lines.zh: 绕过藤蔓，鼻尖始终朝下。
lines.en: It skirts the vines with its snout pointed at the ground.

lines.zh: 沿着切叶蚁的队伍慢慢挪动。
lines.en: It shuffles slowly along a line of leafcutter ants.

lines.zh: 前爪偶尔刨两下，翻出湿泥。
lines.en: Now and then it scrapes the ground and turns up damp dirt.

lines.zh: 走过蚁丘旁，脚步忽然放轻。
lines.en: Passing an anthill, its steps suddenly go quiet.

lines.zh: 长舌在嘴外卷了一下又收回。
lines.en: Its long tongue curls out once, then slips back in.

lines.zh: 穿过蕨丛时，背脊像一块旧毛毯。
lines.en: Pushing through ferns, its back looks like an old blanket.

lines.zh: 走路很慢，鼻子却忙个不停。
lines.en: It walks slowly, but its nose never stops working.

lines.zh: 爪子敲在石块上，发出轻响。
lines.en: A claw taps a stone and makes a small clicking sound.

lines.zh: 停在一棵倒木前，先嗅再跨。
lines.en: It halts at a fallen log, sniffs, then steps over.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩得很实，像在称重量。
lines.en: Each step lands firmly, as if weighing the ground.

lines.zh: 闻到蚁酸味，脚步立刻偏了过去。
lines.en: Catching the smell of formic acid, it veers at once.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子探进蚁丘缝里，慢慢走。
lines.en: I push my snout into a mound crevice and shuffle on.

lines.zh: 踩到软土，脚陷下去半寸。
lines.en: My foot sinks half an inch into soft earth.

lines.zh: 六条腿，还是不够快。
lines.en: Six legs, still not fast enough.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过一千遍。
lines.en: Walked this path a thousand times.

lines.zh: 数不清走过多少回了。
lines.en: Lost count of how many trips.

lines.zh: 数着步子就不会迷路。
lines.en: Counting steps keeps me from getting lost.

lines.zh: 慢慢走，别惊动上面那个。
lines.en: Easy now — don't startle the one above.

lines.zh: 别回头，后面没东西。
lines.en: Don't look back. Nothing there.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在旧路上。
lines.en: Every step lands on someone's old trail.

lines.zh: 窸窣……脚下的土在动。
lines.en: *click click* — the dirt moves beneath me.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子。
lines.en: Don't step on my shadow.

lines.zh: 前面有股甜味。
lines.en: Something sweet up ahead.

lines.zh: 这条路太亮了。
lines.en: This path is far too bright.

lines.zh: 再走十步就休息。
lines.en: Ten more steps, then a rest.

lines.zh: 我的触角先到了。
lines.en: My antennae arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 谁在地上撒了这么多叶子？
lines.en: Who scattered all these leaves?

lines.zh: 左边第三条腿有点酸。
lines.en: My third left leg aches.

lines.zh: 走路比蜕皮轻松。
lines.en: Walking beats molting.

lines.zh: 坐在蚁丘边，等蚂蚁自己爬出来。
lines.en: Sitting by the anthill, waiting for ants to crawl out.

lines.zh: 用后爪挠耳朵，眼睛半闭着。
lines.en: It scratches its ear with a hind claw, eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 舔了舔鼻尖，把土蹭掉。
lines.en: It licks the tip of its snout and wipes the dirt away.

lines.zh: 长舌卷起一只落单的蚂蚁。
lines.en: Its long tongue scoops up a stray ant.

lines.zh: 卧在树根间，尾巴盖住自己。
lines.en: It lies among the roots with its tail draped over itself.

lines.zh: 打了个哈欠，露出细长的舌头。
lines.en: It yawns, showing a thin, ribbon-like tongue.

lines.zh: 抬头闻风，胡须轻轻抖动。
lines.en: It lifts its head to test the wind, whiskers quivering.

lines.zh: 前爪互相搓着，像在擦工具。
lines.en: It rubs its foreclaws together, as if cleaning tools.

lines.zh: 盯着地面一队蚂蚁看了很久。
lines.en: It stares a long while at a column of ants on the ground.

lines.zh: 把鼻子埋进土里，只露出后脑。
lines.en: It buries its snout in the soil, showing only the back of its head.

lines.zh: 背上落了几片叶子，它也懒得抖。
lines.en: Leaves settle on its back and it cannot be bothered to shake them.

lines.zh: 靠着真菌，慢慢嚼刚挖出的块根。
lines.en: Leaning on a fungus, it slowly chews a tuber it just dug up.

lines.zh: 谁在远处敲东西？
lines.en: Something taps far away.

lines.zh: 数一数有多少粒沙。
lines.en: Counting grains of sand.

lines.zh: 我在想……想什么来着？
lines.en: I was thinking... of what?

lines.zh: 就这样待着吧。
lines.en: Just staying like this.

lines.zh: 我好像忘了要做什么。
lines.en: I forget what I was doing.

lines.zh: 天花板真好看。
lines.en: The ceiling is lovely today.

lines.zh: 六条腿都站着，好累。
lines.en: Standing on all six is tiring.

lines.zh: 今天该蜕皮了吗？
lines.en: Is today a molting day?

lines.zh: 世界好大，我好小。
lines.en: The world is huge. I am small.

lines.zh: 风停了。
lines.en: The wind has stopped.

lines.zh: 这片叶子像我。
lines.en: This leaf looks like me.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见自己。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear myself.

lines.zh: 歪着头，先闻你的靴子再闻你。
lines.en: Head tilted, it sniffs your boots first, then you.

lines.zh: 一只眼睛盯着你，鼻子还在动。
lines.en: One eye fixed on you while its nose keeps working.

lines.zh: 把你从头到脚闻了一遍，没什么兴趣。
lines.en: It sniffs you from head to foot and loses interest.

lines.zh: 慢慢眨眼，像在判断你是不是蚂蚁。
lines.en: A slow blink, as if deciding whether you count as an ant.

lines.zh: 长鼻朝你抬起来，喷出一口气。
lines.en: Its long snout lifts toward you and puffs out a breath.

lines.zh: 爪子往土里按了按，没有起身。
lines.en: It presses a claw into the dirt but does not rise.

lines.zh: 侧过身，让你看见它挂着的长舌。
lines.en: It turns sideways, letting you see the tongue hanging out.

lines.zh: 闻到你手上的味道，胡须停住了。
lines.en: Catching a scent on your hand, its whiskers freeze.

lines.zh: 视线越过你，落在你身后的蚁丘上。
lines.en: Its gaze slides past you to the anthill behind.

lines.zh: 盯了一会儿，低头继续舔自己的爪。
lines.en: After a stare, it lowers its head and goes back to licking its claws.

lines.zh: 好大一只……东西。
lines.en: Such a big... thing.

lines.zh: 又一个巨人。
lines.en: Another giant. Great.

lines.zh: 好，我记住你了。
lines.en: Fine. I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛都看见你了。
lines.en: All eight eyes see you.

lines.zh: 你会不会踩下来？
lines.en: Are you going to step on me?

lines.zh: 长舌头一伸，切叶蚁就没了。
lines.en: One flick of my tongue and the leafcutter is gone.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的路啦。
lines.en: You're on my path.

lines.zh: 切叶蚁的味道，蚂蚁都不够。
lines.en: Leafcutter ants never fill me up.

lines.zh: 退后一点点。
lines.en: Back up a little.

lines.zh: 别弯腰，我怕。
lines.en: Don't bend down. It scares me.

lines.zh: 它猛地立起，爪子朝你劈下来。
lines.en: It rears up sharply, claws chopping down at you.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，它反而把身体撑得更高。
lines.en: Struck once, it only draws itself up taller.

lines.zh: 痛哼一声，长鼻甩到一边。
lines.en: With a pained grunt, its snout whips to one side.

lines.zh: 它退开半步，爪子却举得更高了。
lines.en: It gives half a step, claws rising higher instead.

lines.zh: 背上的毛全竖起来，像块刺毯。
lines.en: The fur on its back bristles into a spiky rug.

lines.zh: 它低头护住腹部，尾巴夹紧。
lines.en: It ducks to guard its belly, tail tucked tight.

lines.zh: 爪子在土里抓出四道深痕，全是火气。
lines.en: Its claws gouge four deep lines in the dirt, all temper.

lines.zh: 打中它的鼻子，它打了个响亮的喷嚏。
lines.en: Hitting its snout earns a loud sneeze.

lines.zh: 它转身的速度比你想的快得多。
lines.en: It turns far faster than you expected.

lines.zh: 一声闷叫之后，它开始认真了。
lines.en: After one muffled cry, it stops holding back.

lines.zh: 好疼，真的疼。
lines.en: That hurts. Really.

lines.zh: 让我缓一缓。
lines.en: Give me a moment.

lines.zh: 这不算完。
lines.en: Not over yet.

lines.zh: 谁在偷袭？
lines.en: Who's hitting me?

lines.zh: 好痛，我退后。
lines.en: It hurts. Falling back.

lines.zh: 我的触角断了。
lines.en: My antenna broke.

lines.zh: 我还能动。
lines.en: I can still move.

lines.zh: 我的腿麻了。
lines.en: My leg went numb.

lines.zh: 谁动的手？
lines.en: Who struck me?

lines.zh: 我抱着尾巴，在原地打转。
lines.en: I hug my tail and spin in place.

lines.zh: 闻到蚂蚁的味道，长鼻直直伸过来。
lines.en: Smelling ants, its long snout stretches straight toward you.

lines.zh: 你把切叶蚁放在地上，它立刻凑近。
lines.en: Set a leafcutter ant down and it closes in at once.

lines.zh: 盯着你手里的蚁巢碎块，尾巴翘起。
lines.en: It eyes the anthill chunk in your hand, tail raised.

lines.zh: 为了那几粒蚁蛹，它肯跟你走很远。
lines.en: For a few ant pupae, it will follow you a long way.

lines.zh: 舌头先伸出来，在空气里试味道。
lines.en: Its tongue comes out first, tasting the air.

lines.zh: 鼻子凑到罐口，整张脸差点埋进去。
lines.en: Its snout reaches the jar mouth, nearly burying its whole face.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃蚁丘土，它就往前挪一步。
lines.en: Shake the anthill soil and it advances one step.

lines.zh: 为了挖出底下的真菌，它把爪都用上了。
lines.en: To reach the fungus underneath, it puts both claws to work.

lines.zh: 见了蚂蚁就忘了怕人，鼻子贴你的手。
lines.en: Forgetful of fear at the ants, its nose presses to your hand.

lines.zh: 试探着抬起前爪，想扒你的口袋。
lines.en: It tentatively lifts a foreclaw, meaning to dig into your pocket.

lines.zh: 这不是陷阱吧？
lines.en: This isn't a trap, right?

lines.zh: 别拿走，别拿走。
lines.en: Don't take it away.

lines.zh: 好香，头有点晕。
lines.en: So fragrant. My head spins.

lines.zh: 叶子！我闻到了。
lines.en: leaves! I smell it!

lines.zh: 分我一半。
lines.en: Share half with me.

lines.zh: 就舔一下。
lines.en: Just one lick.

lines.zh: 我排了很久的队。
lines.en: I've queued a long time.

lines.zh: 我的口水……我没有口水。
lines.en: My drool— I have no drool.

lines.zh: 闻起来像小虫。
lines.en: Smells like bugs.

lines.zh: 先看，再碰，再吃。
lines.en: Look, touch, eat.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞过来，比看上去沉得多。
lines.en: Its shoulder comes across, heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 爪子在你腿上刮了一下，土屑直掉。
lines.en: A claw scrapes your leg and clods of dirt fall away.

lines.zh: 尾巴从你膝上扫过，像湿绳子。
lines.en: Its tail sweeps your knee like a wet rope.

lines.zh: 鼻子顶住你的腰，把你推开半步。
lines.en: Its snout presses your hip and shoves you half a step.

lines.zh: 撞完也不道歉，继续往蚁丘走。
lines.en: After the bump it offers no apology and keeps walking to the anthill.

lines.zh: 一撞之下，你靴子上的泥都掉了。
lines.en: The knock alone shakes the mud off your boots.

lines.zh: 它蹭着你转过去，长鼻勾到你的袖子。
lines.en: It brushes past and its snout catches your sleeve.

lines.zh: 前爪踩到你的脚背，稳稳当当。
lines.en: A foreclaw lands on your instep and stays there.

lines.zh: 撞开你之后，它低头检查蚁道。
lines.en: Having bumped you aside, it inspects the ant trail.

lines.zh: 用背脊拱你，像推一块挡路的石头。
lines.en: It shoves you with its back, like pushing a stone out of the path.

lines.zh: 我退一步，你也退。
lines.en: I step back. You too.

lines.zh: 别用脚，用眼睛。
lines.en: Use your eyes, not your feet.

lines.zh: 撞一下，记住你。
lines.en: One bump. Noted.

lines.zh: 我差点翻过去。
lines.en: I nearly flipped over.

lines.zh: 我们两个都该道歉。
lines.en: We both should apologize.

lines.zh: 你急什么？
lines.en: What's your hurry?

lines.zh: 我在原地，你冲过来的。
lines.en: I was standing still. You charged.

lines.zh: 你比石头还硬。
lines.en: You're harder than stone.

lines.zh: 喂！看着路！
lines.en: Hey! Watch the path!

lines.zh: 长舌头差点卷到你靴子上。
lines.en: My tongue nearly curled around your boot.

lines.zh: 两只食蚁兽鼻尖对鼻尖，站着不动。
lines.en: Two anteaters stand nose to nose without moving.

lines.zh: 它替伴侣理了理背上的毛。
lines.en: It tidies the fur along its partner's back.

lines.zh: 一起扒开同一个蚁丘，谁也没抢先。
lines.en: They dig the same anthill without either one rushing ahead.

lines.zh: 尾巴缠在一起，慢慢绕行蚁丘。
lines.en: Tails twined, they circle the anthill at a crawl.

lines.zh: 喉间发出低低的呼噜，像在商量。
lines.en: A low chuffing in the throat, as if working something out.

lines.zh: 它把刚挖出的块根推到对方面前。
lines.en: It nudges a freshly dug tuber toward its partner.

lines.zh: 并排卧着，长舌轮流探进蚁道。
lines.en: Lying side by side, their tongues take turns in the ant tunnel.

lines.zh: 起身时先碰了碰对方的鼻子才走开。
lines.en: Before leaving it touches its partner's nose.

lines.zh: 爪子轻压住伴侣尾尖，不许走远。
lines.en: A claw rests lightly on the partner's tail tip, holding it near.

lines.zh: 两只一起把新蚁丘踩实，像在收拾屋子。
lines.en: Together they tamp down a new anthill, tidying house.

lines.zh: 我的颜色最好看。
lines.en: My colors are the finest.

lines.zh: 我织了张网，等你。
lines.en: I wove a web. For you.

lines.zh: 我准备了很久。
lines.en: I prepared a long time.

lines.zh: 跟我来，这边。
lines.en: Follow me. This way.

lines.zh: 我们才认识一会儿。
lines.en: We only just met.

lines.zh: 别走，再待一会儿。
lines.en: Stay a little longer.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像春天。
lines.en: You smell like spring.

lines.zh: 就这一次，别拒绝。
lines.en: Just this once. Don't refuse.

lines.zh: 我们有很多孩子要养。
lines.en: We'll have many young to raise.

lines.zh: 舌头一卷，切叶蚁就没了。
lines.en: One flick of my tongue takes a leafcutter.

lines.zh: 被抱起来，四只爪子全张开了。
lines.en: Lifted up, all four claws splay wide.

lines.zh: 比看起来重，长尾巴垂在你臂弯外。
lines.en: Heavier than it looks, its long tail hangs past your arm.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子挤到你颈边，痒得厉害。
lines.en: It wedges its snout against your neck, maddeningly ticklish.

lines.zh: 爪尖勾住你的衣角，不肯松开。
lines.en: A claw hooks your hem and will not let go.

lines.zh: 在你怀里扭了两下，就安静了。
lines.en: It wriggles twice in your arms, then goes still.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷住你的手腕，算是抓稳了。
lines.en: Its tail wraps your wrist, which is its idea of a grip.

lines.zh: 一边被抱一边嗅你的口袋。
lines.en: While carried, it keeps sniffing your pocket.

lines.zh: 长舌舔到你手上，黏黏的一下。
lines.en: Its tongue flicks your hand, one sticky touch.

lines.zh: 四肢垂着，像一袋没扎口的粮食。
lines.en: Limbs dangling, it resembles a sack with the top left open.

lines.zh: 放开时它先落地，再回头看你一眼。
lines.en: Set down, it lands first and looks back at you once.

lines.zh: 我背着走。
lines.en: I'll carry it on my back.

lines.zh: 窸窣，藏这里。
lines.en: *click* — hidden here.

lines.zh: 谁掉的？没人？那我的。
lines.en: Dropped? No one? Mine.

lines.zh: 你也要？不行。
lines.en: You want it? No.

lines.zh: 带回去给巢里。
lines.en: Taking it back to the nest.

lines.zh: 太重了，但我不放。
lines.en: Too heavy. Not letting go.

lines.zh: 一块亮亮的东西。
lines.en: A shiny little thing.

lines.zh: 舌头一卷，这味道真怪。
lines.en: My tongue rolls it in; what a strange taste.

lines.zh: 小心，别压坏。
lines.en: Careful. Don't crush it.

lines.zh: 我的窝越来越挤了。
lines.en: My burrow's getting crowded.

lines.zh: 站起来了，两只大爪举到胸前。
lines.en: It rises, both great claws raised before its chest.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声低哼，尾巴绷直。
lines.en: A low growl rolls from its throat, tail going taut.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子压低，前爪开始刨地。
lines.en: It lowers its snout and begins scraping with a foreclaw.

lines.zh: 爪尖对着你，站立时比人还高一头。
lines.en: Claws aimed at you, it stands a head taller than a man.

lines.zh: 认定了目标，就不再闻地面的蚁味。
lines.en: Once fixed on a target, it stops smelling the ground for ants.

lines.zh: 用力吸一口气，胸腔鼓了起来。
lines.en: It draws a hard breath and its chest swells.

lines.zh: 站在你和蚁丘之间，不肯让路。
lines.en: It plants itself between you and the anthill and will not move.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后连拍两下地面。
lines.en: Its tail slaps the ground twice behind it.

lines.zh: 前爪张开，露出里面弯曲的钩。
lines.en: The foreclaws open, showing the curved hooks within.

lines.zh: 它先侧身，把最宽的肩对着来者。
lines.en: It turns sideways, presenting the broadest shoulder to the intruder.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过树皮，发出刺耳的声响。
lines.en: A claw rakes bark and makes a shrill rasp.

lines.zh: 低头、弓背、立起，一气呵成。
lines.en: Head down, back arched, up on two legs, all in one motion.

lines.zh: 看见你了。
lines.en: I see you.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久。
lines.en: I've been hungry a while.

lines.zh: 这个大小的刚好。
lines.en: This size is just right.

lines.zh: 你已经进来了。
lines.en: You're already in it.

lines.zh: 别动，站着。
lines.en: Don't move. Stay still.

lines.zh: 别叫，很快。
lines.en: Don't scream. Quick.

lines.zh: 数到三，就跑吧。
lines.en: Run when I count to three.

lines.zh: 舌头一伸，切叶蚁就没了。
lines.en: One flick of my tongue and the ant is gone.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛都盯着你。
lines.en: Eight eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我的舌头够长。
lines.en: You will not escape my long tongue.

lines.zh: 一次就好。
lines.en: Just once. That's all.

lines.zh: 小虫！是我的。
lines.en: bugs! That's mine.

lines.zh: 围着你侧步打转，爪一直没放下。
lines.en: It circles you in sidesteps, claws never lowering.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈就近半步，节奏很稳。
lines.en: Each circuit closes half a step, steady as a metronome.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的膝盖，那里最好下爪。
lines.en: It stares at your knees, the easiest place to strike.

lines.zh: 鼻子抽动着，记住你身上的气味。
lines.en: Its nose twitches, filing away your scent.

lines.zh: 站姿不变，只有尾巴尖在抖。
lines.en: The stance holds; only the tail tip trembles.

lines.zh: 它试着抬爪，又慢慢放回土里。
lines.en: It lifts a claw, then lowers it slowly to the dirt.

lines.zh: 你退一步，它就进一步，始终贴着蚁道。
lines.en: Step back and it steps in, always on the ant trail.

lines.zh: 目光从你的脚移到肩，再移回来。
lines.en: Its gaze climbs from your feet to your shoulder and back.

lines.zh: 爪子在地上划出一道浅沟，像界线。
lines.en: A claw scores a shallow line in the soil, a boundary.

lines.zh: 它不出声，只让呼吸越来越重。
lines.en: It makes no sound, only its breathing growing heavier.

lines.zh: 绕到上风口，好一直闻着你。
lines.en: It works around to the upwind side to keep your scent.

lines.zh: 前爪一下一下叩着地，等你先动。
lines.en: A foreclaw taps the ground, over and over, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 别躲进草里。
lines.en: Don't hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 喘气声出卖你了。
lines.en: Your breathing gives you away.

lines.zh: 你累了，对吧？
lines.en: Tired, aren't you?

lines.zh: 别跑那么快。
lines.en: Not so fast.

lines.zh: 你的脚印太明显了。
lines.en: Your tracks are obvious.

lines.zh: 石头后面也不行。
lines.en: Behind the rock won't work.

lines.zh: 我还能跑很久。
lines.en: I can run a long time.

lines.zh: 长舌头已经伸到蚁道口。
lines.en: My long tongue is already at the ant trail.

lines.zh: 你在往死路跑。
lines.en: You're running to a dead end.

lines.zh: 再跑，我就生气了。
lines.en: Keep running. I'll get angry.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你。
lines.en: I can smell you.

lines.zh: 转弯没用。
lines.en: Turning won't help.

lines.zh: 立起来一爪拍下，土都震松了。
lines.en: It rears and slashes down hard enough to loosen the soil.

lines.zh: 大爪勾住你的衣襟，往下一扯。
lines.en: A big claw hooks your coat and drags it down.

lines.zh: 两只前爪交替挥出，快得不像它。
lines.en: Both foreclaws strike in turn, faster than it has any right to be.

lines.zh: 一爪扫过来，你听见风被划开。
lines.en: A claw sweeps past and you hear the air being cut.

lines.zh: 它用爪子把你拨开，像拨一根藤。
lines.en: It brushes you aside the way one clears a vine.

lines.zh: 爪尖落在护甲上，划出白痕。
lines.en: Claw tips land on your armor and leave white scores.

lines.zh: 站立时全身压下来，重量都在爪上。
lines.en: Standing, it throws its whole weight behind the claws.

lines.zh: 一记反手，把你掀得倒退三步。
lines.en: A backhand claw sends you staggering back three paces.

lines.zh: 它打完就落回四足，鼻子里喷气。
lines.en: The blow done, it drops to four legs and snorts.

lines.zh: 那一爪下去，蚁丘被削掉半截。
lines.en: That one claw takes the top half off an anthill.

lines.zh: 窸窣！正中。
lines.en: *snap*! Right on target.

lines.zh: 我的牙很利。
lines.en: My fangs are sharp.

lines.zh: 我打到你了。
lines.en: I hit you.

lines.zh: 别怪我。
lines.en: Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 躲得不错，下次呢？
lines.en: Good dodge. Next time?

lines.zh: 我的刺还有毒。
lines.en: My sting still has venom.

lines.zh: 我赢了这一回合。
lines.en: I win this round.

lines.zh: 咬到了！
lines.en: Got you! Right there.

lines.zh: 别小看小个子。
lines.en: Don't underestimate the small.

lines.zh: 我的长爪专挑甲缝。
lines.en: My long claws go for armor seams.

lines.zh: 蕨丛一动，长鼻先从叶下探出来。
lines.en: The ferns stir and a long snout emerges first.

lines.zh: 它从蚁丘背面钻出来，抖了抖背。
lines.en: It comes up from behind the anthill and shakes its back.

lines.zh: 丛林深处多了一只慢吞吞的影子。
lines.en: A slow shadow has appeared deep in the jungle.

lines.zh: 爪子在湿土上留下四道新印。
lines.en: Four fresh claw marks appear in the damp soil.

lines.zh: 它站定，先闻了闻这片林子的味道。
lines.en: It settles and first sniffs the smell of this forest.

lines.zh: 落叶堆里翻出一只食蚁兽，尾上带土。
lines.en: An anteater turns up out of the leaf pile, dirt on its tail.

lines.zh: 树上滴下水，砸在它长鼻上。
lines.en: Water drips from the canopy and lands on its snout.

lines.zh: 它绕着新蚁丘走了半圈，像在验货。
lines.en: It walks half around the new anthill, as if inspecting goods.

lines.zh: 低沉的哼声从树根间传出来。
lines.en: A low grunt comes from among the roots.

lines.zh: 一只还没睡醒的食蚁兽，爪子半收着。
lines.en: A half-awake anteater, claws only partly folded.

lines.zh: 风从哪边吹来的？
lines.en: Which way is the wind?

lines.zh: 我从哪里来？
lines.en: Where did I come from?

lines.zh: 我用长鼻子探了探新土。
lines.en: I probe the new soil with my long snout.

lines.zh: 肚子好饿。
lines.en: I'm so hungry.

lines.zh: 谁把我放在这儿？
lines.en: Who put me here?

lines.zh: 好亮，眼睛疼。
lines.en: So bright. My eyes ache.

lines.zh: 这地方味道陌生。
lines.en: Unfamiliar smell here.

lines.zh: 我记住了这条路。
lines.en: I'll remember this spot.

lines.zh: 刚出来就要干活？
lines.en: Work already? Really?

lines.zh: 窸窣……我醒了。
lines.en: *click* — I'm awake.

lines.zh: 毛上带着火，它打着转往土里蹭。
lines.en: Fur alight, it spins and rubs itself into the dirt.

lines.zh: 烫！我的壳在响。
lines.en: Hot! My shell is crackling.

lines.zh: 落地时四肢撑开，爪子先着地。
lines.en: It lands splayed, claws touching down first.

lines.zh: 我的腿抓不住。
lines.en: My legs can't grip.

lines.zh: 长鼻高举出水面，拼命吸气。
lines.en: Its snout stretches above the water, gasping.

lines.zh: 拉我上去！
lines.en: Pull me up!

lines.zh: 被震得侧翻，爪子在空中乱抓。
lines.en: Blown onto its side, claws scrabbling at the air.

lines.zh: 我被掀翻了。
lines.en: I got flipped over.

lines.zh: 箭插在厚毛里，它低头去咬。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in its thick fur and it bends to bite it.

lines.zh: 箭扎在背毛里，谁干的？
lines.en: An arrow in my back fur — who did that?

lines.zh: 它对着空气嗅了嗅，找不到伤在哪。
lines.en: It sniffs the air, unable to find where the hurt came from.

lines.zh: 长舌头都麻了，卷不起来。
lines.en: My long tongue is numb and won't curl.

lines.zh: 找不到蚂蚁，它开始扒自己的蚁丘。
lines.en: With no ants to find, it starts digging up its own anthill.

lines.zh: 蚂蚁呢？一只都找不到了。
lines.en: Where are the ants? Not one left.

lines.zh: 雷落后，它背上的毛全焦了一撮。
lines.en: After the strike, a patch of its back fur is singed.

lines.zh: 雷打中我了？
lines.en: Did lightning hit me?

lines.zh: 它伸着长鼻往下探，像还要找蚁道。
lines.en: Its snout reaches downward, still hunting an ant tunnel.

lines.zh: 我的长舌头卷不到虚空里的蚁。
lines.en: My long tongue cannot reach ants in the void.
